events.description: A man is violently thrown and slammed onto the ground in a dim, debris-filled space; he struggles and is struck repeatedly, indicating mutual or one-sided physical combat.
After being thrown down, the man on the ground appears subdued and is subjected to repeated strikes by an unseen assailant, consistent with attacking a helpless victim.
Two men are engaged in close physical contact: one grips the other’s chest/shoulder area while both display tense postures, suggesting an ongoing or imminent physical confrontation.
A person is violently thrown backward and lands on the ground in a dimly lit, debris-filled space; the motion suggests being struck or thrown by an unseen force or opponent.
A figure on the ground appears to be subdued or attacked by another individual who is leaning over them, consistent with an assault on a helpless victim.

Two men are engaged in a physical confrontation: one man (in light suit) has his hand placed firmly on the other’s chest/shoulder while maintaining close proximity and tense posture, indicating active restraint or aggressive engagement.
A man in a dark jacket is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip.
A bright, sudden flash and expanding fireball with smoke erupts on the right side of the frame, consistent with an explosion.
Two men are engaged in close physical combat: one grabs the other’s arm/shoulder while the second appears to be resisting or counter-grappling.
A man in a light suit stands over a prone, helpless man on the ground and repeatedly strikes or presses down on him, consistent with physical abuse.

A man in a light-colored suit stands over another man who is on his knees and then on the ground, repeatedly striking or pressing down on him in a dominant, non-consensual manner; the victim appears helpless and does not retaliate.
A man in a light suit stands over another man who is on the ground, cowering and covering his head; the standing man appears to be threatening or assaulting him.
The standing man draws and holds a red-handled object (likely a knife or pistol) while continuing to loom over the prone, helpless victim, indicating an ongoing threat or assault.

A standing man in a light suit holds a red object (likely a knife) while a second man is on his knees, then collapses forward onto the ground; the standing man maintains dominance over the prone individual throughout the sequence.
In close-up frames f14–f15, the prone man grabs the standing man's leg and appears to struggle or resist, indicating mutual physical engagement at that moment.
A standing man in a light suit holds a red object (likely a knife) while a second man kneels and then collapses at his feet, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
The kneeling man grabs the standing man's leg and the red object, suggesting a struggle or attempt to disarm during the assault.

The kneeling man is now lying prone on the ground, appearing incapacitated, while the standing man remains over him with the red object still in hand—consistent with continued abuse of a helpless victim.
